passages.listening_text: M: Hi, Alice. Where did you go on vacation? W: Well, I went to the countryside with my friends. M: Really? What did you do there? W: We climbed the mountains and went hiking and fishing. M: Sounds good. How long did you stay there? W: For two days. M: And how did you go there? W: We rode our bicycles. M: Really? Cool! How was the weather there? W: It was sunny and warm. M: Did you meet any farmers there? W: Of course. And we talked to them. Their life is getting better and better now. Most of them have computers in their homes or have their own cars. M: Great! Did you have a good time there? W: Yes, we did. And I hope to go there again next vacation.

questions.content:
1．Where did Alice go on vacation?
A．To the beach.
B．To the countryside.
C．To her friend’s home.

2．Alice and her friends didn’t ________ there.
A．climb mountains
B．go hiking and fishing
C．play computer games

3．How did they go there?
A．By bus.
B．By car.
C．By bicycle.

4．Who did they meet there?
A．Some farmers.
B．Some foreigners.
C．Some actors.

5．How was Alice’s vacation?
A．Not bad.
B．Great.
C．Terrible.

passages.listening_text: A: Mrs. White, your garden is so big. I like it very much. B: Thank you, Tim. I’ll show you around the garden. A: Great. What do you plant here, Mrs. White? B: Some flowers and tomatoes. Look there. Those are apple trees. A: Oh, I can see some fruits. Do you keep any animals? B: Yes, we have four ducks, seven chickens and three sheep. A: Wow, you must do a lot of work. B: That’s right, look after these plants and animals, find eggs...But it makes me happy. A: Can you show me where to find eggs? B: Sure, come with me.

questions.content:
6．What does Mrs. White plant in the garden?
A．Potatoes.
B．Tomatoes.
C．Orange trees.

7．How many sheep does Mrs. White keep?
A．Three.
B．Four.
C．Seven.

8．What does Mrs. White think of doing the garden work?
A．Fun.
B．Easy.
C．Hard.

passages.listening_text: I’m Li Lin. I’m Chinese. There are many traditional festivals in China. I like the Mid-Autumn Festival best of all the Chinese festivals. My family usually have a big dinner to celebrate the festival. We like to eat mooncakes and enjoy the moon in the evening. I’d like to eat mooncakes with meat because my favorite food is meat. The mooncakes are very delicious. When we eat the mooncakes, my grandmother likes to tell me some stories about Chang’e. I love the stories very much.

questions.content:
9．What festival is Li Lin talking about?
A．The National Day.
B．The Mid-Autumn Festival.
C．The Lantern Festival.

10．What is Li Lin’s favourite food?
A．Apples.
B．Eggs.
C．Meat.

11．Who likes to tell stories to Li Lin?
A．Her grandmother.
B．Her grandfather.
C．Her mother.
